## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/site.py check`
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `python scripts/site.py build`
- [ ] Relevant desktop, mobile, keyboard, and reduced-motion checks completed, or marked not applicable below.

Add screenshots for visual changes and note any checks not performed.

## Content and deployment

- [ ] New public assets are listed in `site-files.json`, if applicable.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the change.
- [ ] No secrets, local backups, or generated output are included.
